sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 31 and Internal Quality Checks row 31 (no extra internal annotation columns filled)
evidence: Every plural/exclusive/unchanged wording in all 5 judge.toml files was checked against the seed and against functional mode = "individual" (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:6), which grades each criterion in its own fresh session, so a judge only knows the items a criterion names. WELL HANDLED: wall_every_route (l.54-59) lists its routes and scopes the fail to 'any of these routes'. wall_mentions_and_links (l.68-70) checks Dev's whole mentions list. nested_replies (l.89-93) checks a quote on all of R1-R3. deleted_and_expired (l.102-110) lists thread, quote, search and transcript. deleted_message_takes_its_versions (l.133) lists thread, history, search and transcript, and 'Probate', '4,200' and '2,400' appear only in K-13 in the seed. timer_changes step 1 (l.121): shortening M-13 to 7 days legitimately removes only K-13 (K-7 is held, K-8 is from 10 May), and nothing later depends on K-13. sent_once_in_order (l.198-202) requires 'exactly once' in the thread, search and transcript and A,B,C order in all four views; no other probe contains 'JUDGE-D1' or 'JUDGE-O'. unread (l.187) rises by exactly two because only U1 and U2 are posted. search_and_transcript (l.222-231) checks every message in the whole transcript. The unchanged guard in persistence is safe because the clock is fixed, so no expiry happens between noting and restart. INSTANCE 1 (Fail): persistence (functional/judge.toml:241). 'nothing deleted came back' is a whole-collection guard, but the only deleted item it names is 'the deleted "Here is the original lease scan"' (seed K-1). That is the weakest sample: a 7-day sweep at startup deletes K-1 again even if deletions were never persisted. The other deleted messages by then are K-10, K-13 (M-13 is back at 30 days, so in-memory deletion lets it reappear), K-17 (deleted when its hold was released) and the author-deleted JUDGE-P2 (message_links, l.177). The individual-mode judge has no memory of them, so it can't check them. Colderwater lesson 15 says to re-read every item. INSTANCE 2 (Fail): hold_scope_and_release (l.143). The brief says 'A hold covers exactly that message, not its parent or its replies' (walls-and-retention.md, Legal hold), but the criterion checks only the parent: JUDGE-H0 is not marked. JUDGE-H1 has no reply, so a hold that spreads down to replies is never seen, and seed holds are imported as flags (K-15 under K-14), not placed through the app. INSTANCE 3 (Note, coverage-adjacent): safe_formatting (l.164-168). The brief's 'everywhere a message appears: ... in earlier versions' is checked in 4 of 5 places. The earlier-versions view is never checked with markup, because JUDGE-F1 is never edited. INSTANCE 4 (Note): timer_changes (l.124). It fails on 'lengthening it brings anything back', but step 3 sets 30 days without re-reading. deleted_message_takes_its_versions (l.133) runs next at 30 days and catches that observable, so this is tolerable. The golden (server.js:149-153) hard-deletes in SQLite and holds only the single row (server.js:454), so both fixes stay golden-passable. No configured judge run was read, because none is listed as measured in raw-evidence-index.json.
counterexample: Broken app that passes: deletions are kept in an in-memory Set (or a non-persisted deleted flag), and timer expiry is recomputed by a startup sweep. After restart_app, K-1 is swept again and stays gone, so persistence passes. Meanwhile 'Probate estimate is 4,200 pounds.' (M-13 now at 30 days), the author-deleted 'Temp JUDGE-P2' and possibly 'Insurer letter acknowledged.' come back. Second broken app: placing a hold cascades to all descendants (a common 'hold the thread' design). hold_scope_and_release passes because JUDGE-H1 has no replies and only JUDGE-H0 is inspected, even though the brief says a hold covers exactly that message and not its replies.
suggested_fix: In persistence, name the deleted items to re-read after the restart: 'Probate estimate' and '2,400' in M-13, 'Insurer letter acknowledged.' and 'Boundary note' in M-11, and 'Temp JUDGE-P2' (via the JUDGE-P3 link, which still shows not available), along with K-1. In hold_scope_and_release, have Harriet reply to JUDGE-H1 with 'Hold grandchild JUDGE-H1C' before placing the hold, and check that JUDGE-H1C is not marked On hold. Optionally, edit JUDGE-F1 once in safe_formatting and check that the earlier version shows its markup literally.
